story.iWant: to receive weekly email notifications with new recommendations and digest summaries
story.soThat: I'm proactively informed about optimization opportunities without needing to check the dashboard daily

tasks.task: Add email preference fields to User model (AC: #5, #8) - emailNotificationsEnabled Boolean @default(true) - emailDigestFrequency String @default("weekly") // "weekly" | "off" - emailUnsubscribeToken String? @unique - timezone String @default("UTC") - lastDigestSentAt DateTime? - Migration: npx prisma migrate dev --name add-email-preferences - Backfill: generate unsubscribeTokens with crypto.randomUUID() for existing users

Create weekly digest email template (AC: #2, #3, #4, #7) - File: src/emails/weekly-digest.tsx - Props: { userName, businessName, recommendations: DigestRecommendation[], conversionTrend, implementationWins[], unsubscribeUrl, dashboardUrl } - Sections: Header, Top 2-3 recommendations with deep links, Quick stats, Implementation wins (conditional), Footer + unsubscribe - Inline styles only; brand color #7c3aed; mobile-responsive single-column; min font 16px; touch targets 44px - Alt text on all images; semantic HTML

Create weekly digest Inngest scheduled function (AC: #1) - File: src/inngest/weekly-digest.ts - Cron: { cron: "0 8 * * 1" } (Monday 8am UTC) - Per-user step.run for retries; idempotency via lastDigestSentAt (skip if <6 days ago) - Fetch top 2-3 NEW recommendations sorted by impact; skip user if none - Reuse implementation-tracker metrics for conversion trend - Send via Resend from insights@metricfortune.app - Update lastDigestSentAt after successful send - Register in src/app/api/inngest/route.ts

Create significant metric change notification (AC: #6) - File: src/inngest/metric-change-notify.ts - Triggered by event: "metrics/significant-change" (conversion rate drops >20% WoW) - Inline simple alert template (no separate template file needed for MVP) - Respect emailNotificationsEnabled preference - Register in src/app/api/inngest/route.ts

Build email preferences settings UI (AC: #5) - Update src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/settings/page.tsx — add Email Notifications section - New Client Component: src/components/dashboard/email-preferences-form.tsx - Controls: weekly digest toggle, timezone selector (Intl.supportedValuesOf or ~20 hardcoded), save button - Save triggers updateEmailPreferences Server Action

Create email preferences Server Action (AC: #5) - File: src/actions/email-preferences.ts ('use server') - export async function updateEmailPreferences(data: EmailPreferencesInput): Promise<ActionResult> - Auth check: auth() + session.user.id guard (pattern: recommendations.ts:596-629) - Validate: emailNotificationsEnabled (boolean), emailDigestFrequency ("weekly"|"off"), timezone (string, max 50 chars) - prisma.user.update + revalidatePath('/dashboard/settings') - Return { success: true } or { error: string }

Create unsubscribe API endpoint (AC: #8) - File: src/app/api/unsubscribe/route.ts - GET /api/unsubscribe?token=<token> - Lookup by emailUnsubscribeToken; set emailNotificationsEnabled = false - Redirect to /unsubscribed confirmation page - New page: src/app/unsubscribed/page.tsx - No auth required (token is the credential)

Write unit and integration tests - tests/unit/inngest/weekly-digest.test.ts — digest filtering logic (skip no-recs, skip recent, correct rec selection) - tests/unit/emails/weekly-digest.test.ts — template renders with various data shapes - tests/integration/email/email-preferences.test.ts — updateEmailPreferences Server Action (auth, ownership, validation) - tests/integration/email/unsubscribe.test.ts — GET /api/unsubscribe (valid token, invalid token, already unsubscribed) - Follow Vitest patterns in tests/unit/services/implementation-tracker.test.ts - Mock Resend in all tests; real DB for integration tests

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Weekly digest email sent every Monday morning (user's configured timezone, default UTC)
Email contains: Top 2-3 new recommendations with one-sentence summaries and impact level
One-click deep links from email directly to recommendation detail view in dashboard
Email also includes: Quick stats (conversion rate trend this week vs last week) and implementation wins (positive trend results from Story 2.6 data)
Email preferences manageable in user settings page: frequency (weekly/off), notification types
Transactional emails sent for: significant metric changes (conversion rate drops >20% week-over-week)
Email templates are mobile-responsive and accessible (semantic HTML, alt text, sufficient contrast)
Unsubscribe functionality: one-click unsubscribe link in every email, compliant with CAN-SPAM/GDPR

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Email service: Resend (resend ^6.2.0) + React Email (@react-email/components ^0.0.25, react-email ^4.2.3). Background jobs: Inngest 3.44.4 for scheduled (cron) and event-triggered functions. All async — zero impact on dashboard response times.

doc.title: Testing Strategy
doc.snippet: Unit tests mock Inngest client and test job logic in isolation. Integration tests use real DB. Mock external services (Resend, Inngest) in unit tests. Follow Arrange-Act-Assert pattern with describe blocks mapped to acceptance criteria.

Gold standard for Inngest function structure: createFunction with id/name/retries, step.run per item for per-item retries, structured logging, error handling returning partial results. weekly-digest.ts MUST follow this pattern.
Shows combined cron + event trigger pattern and step.run usage for scheduled jobs. Reference for weekly-digest cron configuration.

Conversion rate and cart abandonment calculation logic. Weekly digest job should reuse calculateConversionRate-equivalent patterns to compute this-week vs last-week conversion trend (AC #4).

constraints.constraint: Inngest registered functions must be added to the serve() array in src/app/api/inngest/route.ts — both weeklyDigestJob and metricChangeNotifyJob.
React Email requires inline styles only — no CSS classes, no Tailwind, no external stylesheets. All styles must be JS objects.
Per-user step.run in the weekly digest job — wrap each user's send in its own step.run(`send-digest-${user.id}`) to enable per-user retries and prevent partial failures blocking others.
Idempotency guard required: check lastDigestSentAt; skip user if digest sent within last 6 days (differenceInDays check).
Unsubscribe endpoint (/api/unsubscribe) requires NO authentication — the emailUnsubscribeToken IS the credential. CAN-SPAM/GDPR compliance.
Consider adding import 'server-only' to service files used exclusively server-side (from Story 2.6 review).
Environment variables required: RESEND_API_KEY (email sending), NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL (deep link base URL). Verify both exist in .env before implementing.
Digest sending is async via Inngest — must have zero impact on dashboard response times (<500ms navigation NFR).
Brand color for email template: #7c3aed (Bold Purple). Mobile-responsive: single-column layout, min font-size 16px, touch-friendly buttons min 44px height.
Run npm run build before marking story done — zero TypeScript errors required (learning from Story 2.6).

Current settings page is "use client" — email preferences form should be a separate Client Component (email-preferences-form.tsx) added as a Card section. Fetch initial preferences either via useEffect or by converting settings page to a Server Component wrapper.

tests.standards: Use Vitest 4.0 for all unit and integration tests. Follow Arrange-Act-Assert structure with describe blocks grouped by function/module. Map tests to AC IDs with inline comments (// AC #1: ...). Mock all external services (Resend client, Inngest) in unit tests using vi.mock().
